reviews.text:
We took our Pomeranian to KraftyK9 Dog Sports after finishing basic obedience somewhere else, and it's been an awesome experience. Our pup totally loves agility, and today's lesson really showed what she can do.

Kerstin and Marcella are great, they do a fantastic job not just training the dogs, but also teaching us humans how to "talk dog," especially with hand signals. It's really neat to see how well dogs respond and get that communication.

My wife even got to work with Mac, Kerstin's dog, which made the whole thing even more special.

The trainers are super patient, know their stuff, and are excellent at working with each dog's unique energy and personality. It was amazing how fast our pup learned things—she's already looking ready for intermediate!

I totally recommend KraftyK9 if you want to get your dog into agility in a fun and supportive spot.
Want somebody who for sure help to build up skills in connection with your lovely dog, this is the right place. I saw the results in few hours after the first training day. Amazing!
Hi Ray! We are sorry to hear about your experience. If there is anything we can do better, please let us know. We are always open to constructive feedback!
Great INDOOR turf facility to train your dogs when it’s too wet or hot outside!
Krafty K9 offers the best puppy classes in Houston!  Meghan is an amazing trainer.  We appreciate her awesome work, and Krafty K9 for offering reliable and positive dog training.
Great place to train your dog. Obedience, Rally, Agility, Nosework.

My Golden and I have been taking scentwork classes at Krafty K9 for well over a year. When we started group classes, we had zero scentwork experience. We’ve taken classes with Marcella since the beginning. Marcella is an excellent teacher, she is knowledgeable, kind, fun, and your biggest cheerleader (both during class and during scentwork trials). She has made the sport approachable for us. It is very helpful that Marcella competes in scentwork with her own dogs, making her an excellent resource for the sport all around. Taking scentwork classes at Krafty K9 has been one of the best things I’ve done with my Golden. It has turned her from a dog that enjoyed sniffing around the neighborhood, to a dog that actually competes in scentwork! I’m so happy that we found Krafty K9 to practice and have fun in scentwork.
